# 🧩 Pull request

## Summary

What changed and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New UI capability
- [ ] 🎨 Styling or responsive improvement
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility improvement
- [ ] 🔐 Security or privacy improvement
- [ ] 📚 Documentation
- [ ] 🧰 Tooling or maintenance

## Scope

- Routes/components:
- User-visible behavior:
- Related issue:

## Screenshots or recording

Attach before/after evidence for visual changes. Remove personal or sensitive information.

## Verification

- [ ] npm ci
- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] Checked affected routes directly
- [ ] Checked refresh/deep-link behavior
- [ ] Checked mobile and desktop layouts
- [ ] Checked keyboard navigation and visible focus
- [ ] Updated docs and known limitations

## Risk review

- [ ] No secrets or credentials added
- [ ] No personal data added to logs or screenshots
- [ ] New assets have known usage rights
- [ ] Placeholder controls are not presented as implemented features

## Notes for reviewer

Anything that needs special attention?
